components.name: robotic mower height of cut adjustment assembly

provenance.quote: A robotic mower height of cut adjustment assembly, comprising:
a height of cut drum secured to a bottom chassis of the robotic mower and having an internal circumferential surface with spiral threads having detents
a motor cup supporting a cutting blade motor and having an external circumferential surface with spiral threads that engage the height of cut drum
a blade shield fastened to the motor cup
a plurality of inserts into the height of cut drum
the blade shield and the motor cup are rotatable to change height of cut
the blade shield and the motor cup are rotatable to change height of cut
the detents on the height of cut drum engaging the detents on the motor cup to hold and maintain the blade shield and motor cup
the detents flex radially outwardly to slide up a plurality of ramped surfaces on the external threads of the motor cup

functionalities.text: move vertically between min and max cutting height

provenance.quote: rotatable one revolution to move the motor cup and blade shield vertically between a minimum and a maximum cutting height
